name: Spawn Elytra - like in Craft Attack
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: knabbiii
description: Take off at spawn without elytra wings, just like on Craft Attack. Double-jump to take off, press F for a speed boost. Perfect for large survival servers.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
